svg.title: Results at a glance
svg.desc: Results at a glance. Cross-validated AUC-PR 0.759 with all 89 features, against 0.041 by chance, ROC AUC 0.952. 0 of 500 degree-preserving randomized wirings reach it; they score 0.712 ± 0.005, empirical p = 0.002. Graph topology alone scores 0.489 against 0.070 ± 0.004 on randomized wirings, p = 0.002. 99 of the 100 highest-scoring types are annotated sex-related, and neuropil features alone reach 0.722, so most of the signal is location.
